design_notes: 第一階段以值得專程搭乘的日本船旅為核心；目前卡片總數由母資料即時計算，不屬於 schema 固定規格，也不代表最終全集。
後續可分階段加入非觀光性質航路，不以A/B/C/D作為程式固定邏輯。
分類、標籤、體驗性質與卡片基準彼此獨立；UI篩選器應由資料自動生成。

fields.card_basis: string; current values ship/route, future values allowed
fields.operation: string; current values year_round/seasonal/scheduled; future values allowed
fields.travel_tip: string; optional; practical trip-planning advice that changes how a traveler uses or plans the experience; empty string means not yet provided
fields.access_tip: string; optional; practical access/transfer advice that reduces walking, confusion, or transfer risk; empty string means not yet provided
fields.scenic_tip: string; optional; practical viewing/seat/timing advice for improving the onboard experience; empty string means not yet provided
fields.last_deep_checked: string (YYYY-MM-DD); date of the last full card-level verification, not a lightweight weekly signal check
fields.next_check: string (YYYY-MM-DD); scheduled next deep review date; may be advanced when change_detected is true
fields.watch_level: string; current values high/medium/low; maintenance priority based on how often decision-relevant facts are likely to change
fields.change_detected: boolean; true when a lightweight monitoring pass finds a change that requires card-level review; reset to false after deep review is completed
fields.check_cycle: string; current values monthly/quarterly/preseason/annual; normal deep-review cadence, independent of emergency change-triggered review
fields.last_signal_checked: string (YYYY-MM-DD); date of the latest lightweight official-source signal scan; independent from last_deep_checked

reserved_policy.future_categories: 新增分類只需加入 categories 與卡片資料，不應修改 renderer 核心邏輯
reserved_policy.counts: 所有總數與分類數量由資料即時計算，不寫死
reserved_policy.migrations: 以 schema_version 管理資料遷移
reserved_policy.tips: travel_tip/access_tip/scenic_tip are independent optional content layers; renderer may hide empty values and should not infer missing tips
reserved_policy.maintenance: weekly maintenance should scan high-change signals rather than re-verify every card; stable cards are reviewed on their check_cycle or when change_detected becomes true
reserved_policy.watch_level: high = schedules/prices/booking rules or seasonal operations change frequently; medium = periodic operational changes; low = mostly stable descriptive content
reserved_policy.change_trigger: when a meaningful change is detected, set change_detected=true and bring next_check forward; after verified update, record last_deep_checked and reset change_detected=false
reserved_policy.signal_scan: lightweight monitoring checks only decision-relevant change signals: suspension/resumption, planned maintenance or dry-dock closures, operating season, timetable, fare, booking/purchase rules, passes/discounts, material vessel changes, and broken/redirected official links
reserved_policy.noise_filter: news posts, publicity copy, event photos, wording-only edits, and other changes that do not alter trip planning should not set change_detected=true
reserved_policy.weekly_flow: weekly scan -> record last_signal_checked -> if no material change keep change_detected=false; if material change set change_detected=true and advance next_check -> perform deep review -> update affected card fields -> set last_deep_checked -> reset change_detected=false -> schedule next_check by check_cycle
